findings.title: Expected reciprocal link offsets do not match SDK semantics
findings.evidence: _expected_edit appends offset=0.0 in both link directions. CreateReciprocalLink computes CalculateRightAxisOffset and stores +offset on A and -offset on B. _matches tolerates coordinates/radii only, then hashes links exactly via json.dumps; 0.0 and -0.0 hash differently. Small legitimate nonzero projection/coordinate rounding can also differ from hardcoded zero.
findings.impact: A valid successful Link call, or missed-completion replay reconciliation of that link, can fail with Native edit differs from exact expected controls/links/policy or Ambiguous native partial edit. Source/actors remain unsaved; no duplicate replay occurs, but the ordinary continuation stops after applying a valid link.
findings.certainty: Static API/serialization mismatch confirmed. Actual current transaction offsets have not been measured; native AddEndpointLink sign-zero normalization was not established.
findings.requested_resolution: Model the installed calculated offset from the frozen endpoint readback, or compare reciprocal offsets numerically under the already established <=0.1cm verifier bound with exact endpoint identities/counts and reciprocal consistency. Canonicalize signed zero for numeric comparisons. Keep exact unchanged-before snapshots and all physical gates; do not suppress this error or replay a present link.
